notes: ⚠️ REQUIRES JAVASCRIPT RENDERING (Playwright/Selenium): This is a GoDaddy/Duda website builder site with heavily obfuscated class names (c1-1, c1-2, etc.). The business listings are loaded dynamically via JavaScript and are NOT present in the static HTML. Static scraping with requests/httpx will NOT work. The selectors provided are educated guesses based on common GoDaddy patterns - they must be verified with a real browser automation tool. The page uses data-ux attributes for components, but actual listing data only appears after JS execution. May also need to handle infinite scroll or click 'Load More' buttons.
